Mais la situation échappe à son contrôle et elle entraîne tous les habitants de la forêt avec elle. Comment réagira son sévère ami l'ours ?

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles décident de monter la pièce " Fraisillon et le prince fraisi-charmant " pour les bébés Petits-Pépins. Elles forcent la main à Coco Berry pour qu'il accepte le rôle masculin. Celui-ci accepte à contre-cœur et les problèmes...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Il était une fois, dans un pays fruité, un roi et une reine d'une grande sagesse. Ils avaient trois filles et devaient décider à laquelle des princesses confier le royaume en leur absence. Pour les départager, ils leur demandèrent de trouver...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est la panique à Fraisi-Paradis. La source de poudre de Petit Pépin tombe en panne et plus personne n'a de jus. Les Petits-Pépins entreprennent de gros travaux qui font beaucoup de bruit. Charlotte et ses amies sont obligées de quitter la...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les travaux entrepris par les Petits-Pépins pour réparer la source de poudre de Petit Pépin ont pris du retard. Le vacarme est assourdissant. Encore une fois Charlotte et ses amies vont être obligées de quitter la ville et de trouver une...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les Petits-Pépins n'ont toujours pas trouvé la source de la panne de courant qui paralyse Fraisi-Paradis depuis plusieurs épisodes. Les travaux continuent donc. Charlotte et ses amies se préparent à passer la nuit sous une tente. Mais Mimi...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les chiens sèment la pagaille à Fraisi-Paradis et les filles décident de leur construire un parc de jeux. Elles font appel à Coco Berry. Mais celui-ci est très maladroit et n'est pas du tout bricoleur. Jusqu'au jour où il trouve un...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le jour de l'ouverture du parc pour chiens est arrivé. Tout est prêt, mais les chiens refusent d'entrer. Les amies avancent différentes hypothèses et tentent diverses approches, sans succès. En fait, les chiens sont effrayés par un chapeau...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles organisent un bal masqué pour fêter l'ouverture du parc pour chiens. Coco Berry n'accepte de venir qu'à la condition expresse que Baba Hortensia reste à ses côtés et qu'il ne soit pas obligé de danser. Mais voilà qu'elle tombe...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Pour remercier Petit Pépin l'Ancien de tous ses travaux sur les fruits et légumes, la Princesse Fraisinette a décidé de lui décerner un prix, le Rutabaga royal, et de déclarer un jour férié en son honneur. Les filles veulent également la...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Lili Framboise et Mimi Citron veulent participer à un concours de mode sur Fraisi-net, lancé par la célèbre Marla, dont le thème est : la technologie au service de la mode. Baba Hortensia les aide à trouver une super idée. Elles demandent...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Charlotte reçoit la visite inattendue de sa cousine Pomme d'Amour, grande voyageuse intrépide qui parcourt le monde. Pomme d'Amour a pour coutume de transformer chaque expérience en aventure épique... pour le meilleur ou pour le pire. Son...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Charlotte et ses amies se préparent pour le grand défilé " La Technologie au service de la Mode " organisé par la célèbre Marla. Lili Framboise part sur une idée de jupe-écran vidéo. Mimi Citron, quant à elle, trouve sa propre idée de...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Doucette et Aigrelette, les jumelles. Aigrelette est contrariée car elle doit systématiquement partager la vedette avec sa sœur ce jour-là. Mais cette année, Doucette a décidé de lui faire le plus beau des cadeaux :...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Toutes les filles partent camper. Doucette décide d'en profiter pour faire déguster aux autres un dessert de sa création à base de guimauves, de lamelles de fraises et d'amandes effilées. Pomme d'Amour, quant à elle, décide de tourner une...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Doucette et Aigrelette de raconter une histoire autour du feu. Aigrelette vole la vedette à sa sœur et improvise une histoire d'aventurière au grand cœur, qui, partie apporter des vivres aux Petits-Pépins Explorateurs, se...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: La nuit est tombée et au campement, c'est l'heure des histoires autour du feu. C'est au tour de Pomme d'Amour de faire à ses amies le récit passionnant d'une course des plus épiques à laquelle elle a participé : la Grande Fraisi-course...

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Dans le ciel, deux nuages ressemblent à Rien-Ne-Sert et Lulu qui courent. Mais qui a gagné ? Frou-Frou organise une vraie course jusqu'à la clairière pour les départager. Pendant ce temps, la maîtresse n'arrive pas en classe. Lulu et Frou-Frou entendent des bruits étranges dans la forêt et partent la chercher.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Les enfants trouvent une carte au trésor dans la classe. Ils décident de partir à sa recherche. Très vite cela devient une vrai compétition entre deux équipes : l'une menée par Lulu, l'autre par Rien-Ne-Sert...Lulu entraîne ses copains dans une sortie nocturne pour observer les étoiles, mais les copains font tout pour rentrer chez eux au plus vite, au grand dam de Lulu.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Coquenpâte pêche un scarabée en lapis lazuli, attirant le fantôme de Toutankhamon qui réclame son trésor. Coquenpâte, sous emprise, menace le poulailler. Grâce à Carmen et Carmélito, il rend le scarabée au fantôme qui disparaît, rendant la paix. Puis Don Quichotte attaque le poulailler, mais l'alliance de nos héros déjoue son plan maléfique.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Poulenstein, monstre-poulet rejeté, gagne la confiance du poulailler grâce à sa soupe d'orties. Quand il perd un boulon, il devient fou, mais Carmen et Carmélito le réparent. Heureux, il est enfin accepté. Pendant ce temps, Hercule, manipulé par Rattila, capture Carmen et Carmélito, mais Bélino et Hercule sauvent la situation en chassant les rats.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: La Tortue, croupière au Babouin's, est piégée dans sa carapace, cimentée ! Trois clients perdants sont suspects. Sherlock enquête, tout en tentant de décrypter un message étrange reçu dans un gâteau. Plus tard, le Gorille videur est assommé. Lion ou Oiseau de paradis ? Sherlock, toujours refusé aux soirées, va devoir apprendre à être plus cool...

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Pendant son entraînement, le Kangourou se casse la main sur un sac rempli de fers à cheval. Sherlock et Hermine enquêtent : Vieux Cheval, Gorille ou Chihuahua ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine offre une voiture à Sherlock, qui cache qu'il n'a pas le permis. Le Singe Hurleur, assommé en chantant, fredonne des chansons douces. Qui est responsable : Castor, Koala ou Boa ?

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Marcus et son équipe doivent libérer un Kapobowl capturé en gravissant un arbre géant, face à Vipkrad. Seuls Marcus et Vipkrad restent, alors ils pactisent pour s'entraider… mais peut-on vraiment faire confiance à Vipkrad ? Puis, Marcus combat aux côtés de Gratrok pour atteindre Vipkrad, mais ce dernier capture Gratrok, forçant Marcus et Ephi à s'allier.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Vipkrad vole un téléporteur pour envahir Atalantis de monstres. Marcus choisit le mode méga-difficile pour impressionner ses amis, mais il se heurte vite à des ennemis trop forts. Par ailleurs, Vipkrad, devenu un colosse grâce à un fragment de miroir, menace le Royaume Bleu. Marcus doit l'escalader et récupérer le fragment pour sauver le royaume.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon repeint la cabane avec Pétunia et Bagout, mais un orage transforme tout en arc-en-ciel… jusqu'à une taupe furieuse ! Après avoir mangé un gâteau en douce, il en refait un avec du liquide vaisselle, pensant que c'est de l'huile. Il éclaire une fête avec des lucioles, brûle sa poupée en jouant avec un fer, et frôle la catastrophe pendant une partie de cache-cache !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pétunia et Grabouillon partent en expédition au bout du jardin, mais la taupe et Bagout causent des problèmes. En cherchant des plantes pour l'herbier, ils fuient un essaim d'abeilles et voient la taupe dévorer un trèfle rare. Grabouillon lave malencontreusement le T-shirt de maman, provoquant une mousse géante, puis se blesse en voulant manger trop de pâtée.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Bagout trouve un cerf-volant que Grabouillon veut attraper, mais il s'envole sur le toit. Après des péripéties, Grabouillon tombe dans les orties. Ils essaient une tyrolienne, puis gonflent une piscine qui explose. Privés de télé, ils récupèrent un poste, mais Bagout, en voulant brancher l'électricité, est interrompu par une guêpe.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon décore un gâteau avec des bonbons et s'enfuit, Pétunia s'inquiète. Bagout fait un feu interdit, et Grabouillon le propage par accident, mais une pluie les sauve. En hiver, Grabouillon perd son téléphone dans la neige, qu'il retrouve grâce à la sonnerie. Une expérience ratée avec de la pâte à sel envahit la cuisine.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pétunia, Grabouillon et Bagout vivent mille aventures dans le jardin : chasse aux étoiles filantes, courses sur glace, réparations de niche ratées, courses d'escargots folles… Malgré les bêtises et les imprévus, leur amitié les aide toujours à s'en sortir, avec humour et complicité.

programme.title: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: En route pour luniversité
programme.desc: Carly apprend que son émission lui ouvre les portes d'une scolarité dans une école privée très cotée. Carly doute encore, mais Sam et Freddie savent qu'ils n'ont pas envie de la voir partir...

programme.title: Adversaires
programme.desc: Freddie part faire de l'escrime avec Spencer. Il s'en sort bien, mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Spencer se retrouve impliqué dans un match avec l'incroyable Doug Toder.

programme.title: Je gagne un rencard
programme.desc: Gibby est trop timide pour demander à la fille qui lui plait de sortir avec lui, le groupe décide alors d'organiser une tranche "je gagne un rendez-vous" sur leur émission.

programme.title: Ma prof est folle
programme.desc: Madame Ackerman, le professeur du groupe, est en pleine rupture avec son petit-ami, ce qui la rend aigrie avec ses étudiants. Une visite de Spencer pour arranger les choses se transforme en rendez-vous.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: Je lai vu la première
programme.desc: Carly et Sam s'intéressent au même garçon, mais elles se jurent qu'il ne sèmera pas la zizanie entre elles. Malheureusement, les choses ne se déroulent pas si facilement et elles finissent par entrer en compétition.

programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: Bobby et les Chasseurs de fantômes
programme.desc: Sanne, 13 ans, raffole des histoires fantastiques que lui raconte son père, Lucas, un chasseur de spectres très réputé.

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Le Maître du jeu
programme.desc: La nouvelle passion du jeune Ivan Drago pour les jeux de société le propulse dans le monde fantastique et compétitif de l'invention de jeux, et l'oppose à l'inventeur Morodian, qui désire depuis longtemps détruire la ville de Zyl, fondée par le grand-père d'Ivan.

programme.title: Lino
programme.desc: Lino, mascotte de fêtes pour enfants, déteste son costume de chat et la façon dont il est traité. Il consulte un magicien pour changer de vie, mais un sort tourne mal. À son réveil, il est piégé dans le costume qu'il voulait fuir.

programme.title: Aladin et la lampe magique
programme.desc: A l'aide d'une lampe magique, un jeune homme pauvre se transforme en prince afin de conquérir le cœur d'une belle princesse.

programme.title: Drive or Die
programme.desc: Michael, un jeune voleur de voitures, est recruté par la police pour infiltrer un gang de trafiquants de véhicules de luxe, mené par les cruels Charlie et Sammy. Jusqu'où pourra-t-il mener ce double jeu dangereux ?

programme.title: Shadow Wolves
programme.desc: Lorsque des terroristes de l'Etat Islamique commencent à se faufiler à travers la frontière américaine en Arizona, le colonel Branson, chef d'une division secrète de la NSA, alerte les Shadow Wolves pour qu'ils les traquent et les arrêtent.

programme.title: Get Fast
programme.desc: Quand son complice est enlevé après un braquage spectaculaire, un voleur notoire se lance à sa recherche sur le territoire d'un impitoyable baron de la drogue. Jusqu'où va la loyauté entre criminels quand les balles commencent à siffler ?

programme.title: Diamonds War
programme.desc: Un ancien combattant de MMA et ses frères doivent sauver leur famille kidnappée d'un dangereux syndicat du crime après le vol de 50 millions de dollars de diamants issus de trafics.

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: Un justicier reçoit la mission de combattre un groupe de démons, les Cavaliers de l'Apocalypse, qui veulent enlever de jeunes enfants pour répandre le Mal sur terre et faire advenir la fin des Temps.

programme.title: A good man
programme.desc: Un ex-militaire reconverti en gardien d'immeuble reprend les armes pour protéger un locataire menacé par un gangster russe, renouant avec son passé pour défendre la justice.

programme.title: The Cellar
programme.desc: La fille de Keira Woods disparaît mystérieusement dans la cave de leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: Wildland
programme.desc: Après la mort de sa mère, Ida, 17 ans, emménage chez sa tante et ses fils. Tandis que la famille est aimante, elle mène une vie criminelle violente, et un meurtre met à l'épreuve leur loyauté.

programme.title: Metro Manila
programme.desc: Oscar Ramirez et sa famille quittent les montagnes philippines pour Metro Manila, où il doit tout risquer pour protéger sa famille dans une ville impitoyable.

programme.title: Yo! Pekin
programme.desc: Le groupe de pop-rappée franco-californien Naive New Beaters crée le buzz en Chine avec une video de danse « Quan Chang Wu » tournée devant la tour Eiffel. Invités par les autorités, David Boring et ses acolytes atterrissent dans la ferveur et la pollution du pays du panda. Mais très vite, leur périple vire au drame diplomatico-politique. Yo! Pekin, le premier « docu-fiction-film d'action-film de vacances »

programme.title: Le commissaire perdrix ne fait pas le voyage pour rien
programme.desc: Anselmini, ancien truand, est un homme seul mais libre. Cette liberté, c'est précisément ce que sont venus prendre le Commissaire Perdrix et le Lieutenant Webb, deux flics perdus dans un pays, dans une temporalité qui ne sont pas les leurs.

programme.title: Tourmente
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a abandonné son équipage lors du naufrage de son bateau, le capitaine Mandarin est maudit par la mer.

programme.title: Ride away
programme.desc: Arrivée au bout de la route, une vieille motarde ressent le besoin de faire un dernier voyage.

programme.title: Automne
programme.desc: Une femme reçoit une lettre adressée à l'ancienne locataire.

programme.title: Tropical suite
programme.desc: Après dix ans de collaboration, Poni Hoax part enregistrer un quatrième album décisif sous les tropiques : Cape Town (Afrique du Sud), São Paulo (Brésil) et Bangkok (Thaïlande). Tropical Suite raconte ce voyage au cœur de la création. Bien plus qu'un making of, ce documentaire révèle la quête musicale et intime d'un des meilleurs groupes de rock français.

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre de mes envies
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'un homme sous influence...

programme.title: Pisseuse
programme.desc: Mona a quinze ans, elle fait encore pipi au lit. Aucun remède ne vient la secourir. Elle trouve seule le chemin de sa liberté.

programme.title: Jafar Panahi, télépathie
programme.desc: Jean-Luc Godard et ses amis de la Cinémamecque croient à la présence de Jafar Panahi même lorsqu'il est absent de sa rétrospective au Centre Pompidou…

programme.title: Living Chiaying
programme.desc: Le portrait d'une danseuse contemporaine à Taiwan, un travail cinématographique en couleur à la “pause B”, en pixilation. Un film frontal où la gestuelle du corps correspond à celle de la caméra. Une interaction entre la rencontre chorégraphique et cinématographique qui décrit au plus proche la tragédie de la solitude de l'artiste. Une réflexion visuelle sur la résilience, les vibrations, les états modifiés de conscience de l'artiste.

programme.title: Bonne poire
programme.desc: Perrine attend un jeune homme qu'elle n'a jamais vu dans un parc, derrière le pavillon des rhododendrons. Pour qu'il la reconnaisse, elle a mis sa robe rayée de toutes les couleurs. Manque de bol : à côté de son banc, une femme porte exactement la même...

programme.title: Superman n'est pas juif (... et moi un peu)
programme.desc: Découvrant que c'est parce qu'il est juif que son zizi est différent, le petit Benjamin décide de tout faire pour cacher sa religion et ainsi préserver son secret…

programme.title: Plaine orientale
programme.desc: C'est le printemps. Dans la Plaine Orientale Corse, la récolte des fruits bat son plein. De nombreux travailleurs venus de loin y trouvent un emploi pour la saison. Mathilde, une jeune cueilleuse de pomelos, évolue entre les deux équipes de son patron. D'un côté, des Européens, de l'autre, des Maghrébins.

programme.title: Grand Hôtel Barbès
programme.desc: Paris, quartier de la Goutte d'or, printemps 2018. Ulysse, 20 ans, misérable et désœuvré, rencontre au détour d'une rue Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Le compositeur autrichien pourrait lui sauver la mise… en échange d'une danse.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood ne veut pas mourir
programme.desc: Dans une demeure isolée, Susan Aylwood, ancienne star du cinéma, vit avec sa gouvernante la discrète Caroline. Entourée de ses souvenirs de gloire, elle mène son entourage à la baguette. Mais quelle terrible vérité se cache derrière les apparences ?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia est entraînée dans un appartement pour une fête. Face à la foule de visages, elle est sans repères, comme perdue dans un paysage de montagne recouvert de nuages.

programme.title: Garage rouge
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon n'ose plus sortir de chez lui après une agression.

programme.title: A perdre haleine
programme.desc: Emile, jeune violoncelliste, est submergé par l'angoisse le jour d'un concert...

programme.title: Léon d'Oural
programme.desc: Au cours d'une prestigieuse course, des chevaux, poussés par les jockeys, enchaînent avec vigueur les obstacles.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Poursuite Mortelle
programme.desc: Un groupe de cinq alpinistes fait de la randonnée et de l'escalade dans les Highlands écossais lorsqu'il découvre une jeune fille serbe enterrée dans une petite chambre en pleine nature. Ils se retrouvent alors pris dans un terrifiant jeu du chat et de la souris avec les ravisseurs, alors qu'ils tentent de mettre la jeune fille à l'abri.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Jack Quinn, l'un des meilleurs agents spéciaux antiterroristes à la retraite, coule des jours heureux avec sa compagne en attendant leur premier enfant. Jusqu'au jour où la réapparition de Stavros, son ennemi juré, l'oblige à repartir en mission...

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Imagine
programme.desc: Une rock-star vieillissante ne souhaite pas changer ses habitudes de vie, jusqu'à ce que son agent lui fasse ouvrir une lettre gardée secrète pendant 40 ans, écrite de la main de John Lennon, le célèbre membre des Beatles. Suite à cette découverte inattendue, Danny Collins va chercher à redécouvrir sa famille et à trouver l'amour.

programme.title: The Midas Touch
programme.desc: Drame sur un garçon de 12 ans qui rêve d'avoir assez d'argent pour pouvoir soigner la grave maladie cardiaque de sa grand-mère. Lorsqu'il se retrouve dans une maison hantée, le mystérieux propriétaire lui « accorde » un vœu : la touche Midas. Le garçon apprend vite que c'est plus une malédiction qu'une bénédiction lorsque tout ce qu'il touche se transforme en or.

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: Bruce Lee: Immortal Dragon
programme.desc: Un regard sur la vie de la superstar Bruce Lee.

programme.title: J'aurais Voulu Etre Un Danseur
programme.desc: François mène une vie paisible et heureuse avec sa ravissante épouse et son jeune fils jusquà ce qu'il découvre pour la première fois la comédie musicale "Singin' in the rain". Hypnotisé, il quitte sa famille pour se consacrer à sa nouvelle et dévorante passion pour les claquettes. Mais il ne sait pas encore que son père et son grand-père ont fait la même chose des années auparavant...

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Après la disparition de son amie à Tijuana, Gloria Meyer se retrouve au centre d'un jeu dangereux joué par la CIA, la DEA et un chef de gang.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: Roses à crédit
programme.desc: Au sortir de la guerre, Marjoline arrive à Paris. Elle devient manucure dans un salon de beauté et épouse Daniel. Elle est au comble du bonheur lorsqu'ils reçoivent en cadeau un appartement au confort moderne. Pour le meubler, elle se couvre progressivement de dettes, malgré l'opposition de Daniel.

programme.title: Layer Cake
programme.desc: Un dealer de cocaïne respecté au sein de l'élite de la mafia anglaise décide de prendre sa retraite. Jimmy Price, un gros caïd, lui demande cependant une dernière faveur: retrouver Charlotte, la fille portée disparue de l'un de ses vieux amis.

programme.title: Le prince et la romancière
programme.desc: Un romancier aide un prince à trouver l'amour avant son mariage, et la réalité reflète la fiction.

programme.title: Mariage sanglant
programme.desc: Pour fuir sa tante, une couturière est prête à tuer la fiancée de l'homme de ses rêves pour l'épouser.

programme.title: Coup de foudre amoureux
programme.desc: Claire Richards, célibataire vivant à Willow Bay et une professeur de biologie passionné de nature.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: L'histoire de la vie du champion de boxe poids lourds, Muhammad Ali. Suivez les débuts du champion en tant que Cassius Clay, son ascension dans le sport et la politique, notamment son refus controversé de participer à la guerre du Vietnam ainsi que ses retours au combat notoires.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Un nouveau venu au lycée (Sean Faris) apprend les arts de combat auprès d'un mentor avisé (Djimon Hounsou) et prouve son talent lors de compétitions d'arts martiaux mixtes clandestins

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: À la suite de l'ouragan Katrina, l'entraîneur de basket-ball du lycée, Al Collins, rassemble des élèves de cinq écoles différentes de Louisiane et les mène jusqu'aux championnats de l'État.

programme.title: Bridge to Terabithia
programme.desc: Jesse et Leslie sont des camarades de classe qui créent un monde imaginaire de monstres, trolls, ogres et géants. Ils l'appellent Terabithia, et y gouvernent comme roi et reine.

programme.title: Droit au but
programme.desc: Après être montée dans le mauvais bus alors qu'elle devait aller étudier les sciences marines, Cory se retrouve obligée d'effectuer un semestre d'étude à l'Académie de Football Harold. D'abord réticente vis-à-vis du foot, Cory finit par se prendre au jeu.

programme.title: Crypto
programme.desc: Martin, un agent de l'agence anti blanchiment d'argent est chargé d'enquêter sur une affaire de fraude et de corruption dans sa ville natale, où son père et son frère luttent pour conserver la ferme familiale.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Sous contrôle judiciaire et contraint de rester chez lui, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passe ses jours à épier ses voisins. La vie suit tranquillement son cours jusqu'à ce que les choses tournent très mal.

programme.title: Président Par Accident
programme.desc: Quelques semaines avant les élections, Washington a besoin de trouver un candidat à la présidence qui soit sûr de perdre. Ils choisissent Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), un politicien inconnu d'un quartier défavorisé de Washington, comme marionnette.

programme.title: Ainsi Va la Vie

Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l'aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu'il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d'art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s'effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s'affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n'en a qu'une.

programme.title: Punch-drunk love
programme.desc: Lauréate de la récompense du Meilleur réalisateur du Festival de Cannes 2002, 'cette histoire d'amour marginale entre des gens déconnectés essayant de se comprendre dans un monde antagoniste est une comédie de gène et de rage qui se transforment soudainement en sentiments purs et doux.' Adam Sandler interprète de façon assez inhabituelle et remarquable le rôle de Barry Egan, le propriétaire d'un magasin de babioles, handicapé social, dominé par ses sept sœurs et qui ne trouvera sans doute pas l'amour de lui-même. Lorsqu'une mystérieuse femme apparait dans sa vie, ses émotions s'affolent, passant d'une colère incontrôlable, à la luxure, au doute de soi. 'Punch-Drunk Love vous laisse confus, avec la tête qui tourne et surmonté par une plaisante sensation déplaisante.' 'Une comédie romantique aussi magnifique qu'étrange qui élargit les limites du genre de façon assez absurde et nous fait croire.' Du réalisateur/scénariste de Boogie Nights et de Magnolia, Punch-Drunk Love est un film sombre, unique et charmant.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz

If they get a second question wrong they have to kneel. And if they get a third question wrong, they are eliminated. 10 contestants compete for one cash prize.

programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: The Rapping Politician & The 90's Rap Icon
programme.desc: Matchmaker Patti Stanger takes on the most challenging clients of her lifetime and this week is no exception. Former politician and current rapper Shawn Isaac aka “Shawn Don” checks in with an unrealistic wish list based on credentials rather than chemistry. He hasn't dated seriously in four years and dumped his only girlfriend because she didn't meet his “resume requirements”. Patti gives Shawn a much-needed love lesson and discovers some shocking information that helps explain Shawn's logistical rather than emotional mindset when it comes to love. But Shawn has a huge secret that could change everything… Meanwhile, 90's Grammy nominated music icon, Monie Love, has to control everything in her universe. At 46 years old, she's feeling the pressure to find Mr. Right and settle down but her micromanaging habits are blocking any chance she has at finding love. Patti discovers Monie's controlling ways stem from her childhood and that deep-rooted behavior brings out the worst in the men she dates. Patti's mission is to transform Monie from an overbearing alpha into a softer, gentler beta, but that winds up being much harder than expected. Will either Shawn or Monie take Patti's advice and find love or will they break her rules and check out of the Millionaire's Club alone?

programme.title: Bad Boy Magnet and The Insta-Ham
programme.desc: This week at the Millionaire's Club, matchmaker Patti Stanger faces off against Tiffany Foxx, a sexy rap artist and star of “Love and Hip Hop.” Tiffany has a type…bad boys, and her 14-year long relationship was with a man who spent 9 of those years in prison! As predicted, Tiffany fails her love lesson and Patti begins to realize that the problem goes deeper, into childhood. An emotional Tiffany finally recognizes she needs to change. But when Patti throws a test into her mingle, will Tiffany revert to type or reach for true love with a good guy? At the same time, Patti and her team take on Christopher Lourdes, who spends his days posting on Instagram. He uses the social media site to flash his wealth and meet women who are only after one thing…his wallet. Patti needs to put the brakes on his social media frenzy and show him that he's only attracting “Instawhores.” A resistant Christopher finally agrees to try things Patti's way but backslides horribly endangering his possibilities to check out with his date. Both Patti's clients this week need to choose their paths wisely. If they don't, Tiffany and Christopher will leave the club alone.

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. Here dogs became our greatest allies. They're our eyes, ears, strength and stamina our closest connection to a wild and unforgiving nature. In this magical yet unforgiving land, the enduring bond between human and canine goes beyond friendship to total mutual dependence. As one of the oldest breeds in the world, Greenland dogs are celebrated as the pinnacle of high performance and endurance in polar regions.

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Wild Waters

Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: Hot Roads

Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers

The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Way Back Home

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Lost Recipes

Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Lock Stock And Two Smoking Tikkas
Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says "no worries!" and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!
